title: Mail
lead: Every email the Studio sent or tried to send in the last {{days}} days. Links from emails are not kept here.
leadShort: Every email the Studio sent or tried to send. Links from emails are not kept here.
caption: Mail log

smtpOff.text: Mail is not set up. Emails are not sent: people get confirmation and invitation links on screen or from you, notifications only in the Inbox.

day.caption: Last 24 hours
day.failedShow: Show emails that failed in the last 24 hours
day.retryingShow: Show emails the Studio will retry on its own

hint.auth: The SMTP server rejects the sign-in. Check the username and password in Mail (SMTP).
hint.connect: The SMTP server does not respond. Check the host, port and connection security.
hint.tls: Could not establish a secure connection. Check the security mode (STARTTLS, TLS).

statusFilter.not_sent: Not sent: mail not set up

failure.auth: The SMTP server rejected the username or password
failure.connect: Could not connect to the SMTP server
failure.timeout: The SMTP server did not answer in time
failure.tls: Could not establish a secure connection
failure.recipient_refused: The SMTP server refused the email for this address
failure.sender_refused: The SMTP server does not accept email from the sender address
failure.data_refused: The SMTP server rejected the whole email
failure.disconnected: The SMTP server dropped the connection

empty.title: No emails yet
empty.body: Every email the Studio sends or tries to send will appear here.

loadFailed: Could not load the mail log.
loadFailedBody: Check the connection and try again.

origin.signing_reinvite: Invitation resent from a signing route

card.title: Email
card.showAll: Show all emails to this recipient
card.linkHidden: Link hidden. Links with tokens (password reset, confirmation, invitation) work like a password, so the log does not keep them. The button in the email does nothing here.
card.rerendered: The email is redrawn with the current template: email texts or layout changed since it was sent. The subject above is the one that was sent.
card.noteHidden: The sender's message is not kept in the log.
card.templateGone: This email type no longer exists in this Studio version, so it cannot be shown.

notFound.title: Email not found
notFound.body: Its record was deleted after the retention period, or the email number in the address is wrong.

next.title: What you can do
next.reset_password: The link in the email is single-use and not kept in the log. Issue a new one in Users: the person's card, "Issue password reset link". Or ask the person to click "Forgot password" again.
next.verify_email: The person can request the email again on the sign-in page: "Send the link again".
next.invite: Send the invitation again in Users, Invitations tab: the old link stops working.
next.email_change: The person repeats the address change in their account settings.
next.project_invitation_link: A project member who can invite may send it again: Access, "Resend".
next.inbox: The notification is in the recipient's Inbox, the email only duplicates it.
next.notice: This is a notice about an account action: the action itself is done, there is no need to repeat the email.
next.smtp_test: Send the test email again in the Mail (SMTP) block.
next.smtpOff: Mail was not set up, so the email did not go out. It will not go out on its own; once mail works, an email without a token link can be sent again.
next.suppressed: The email was not sent: {{reason}}. This is not a failure, the Studio works this way.
next.stale: There is no need to send it again: {{reason}}.
next.retrying: Nothing to do: the Studio will retry on its own.

card.retryPlanned: The Studio will retry {{when}}. Attempt {{next}} of {{max}}.
card.gaveUp: The Studio tried {{n}} times, the email never went out.

resend.hint: The email is rebuilt with the current template and goes out as a new log row.

done.failed: It did not go out this time either: {{reason}}.
done.retrying: The email did not go out, the Studio will retry on its own.
done.blocked: There is no need to send it again: {{reason}}.

resend.failed: Could not send the email again. Try later.

blocked.status: the email was sent or was not meant to be sent
blocked.token_link: the email had a link with a token, such emails are not resent
blocked.smtp_test: send the test email again from the Mail (SMTP) block
blocked.template_gone: this kind of email no longer exists in this version
blocked.retrying: the Studio is still retrying it
blocked.too_old: the email is older than 3 days and is out of date
blocked.already_resent: the email has already been resent and went out
blocked.recipient_changed: the recipient has a different address now
blocked.recipient_blocked: the recipient cannot sign in or has not confirmed their email
blocked.invitation_done: the invitation was already accepted, declined, revoked or has expired
blocked.request_done: the access request was already decided
blocked.transfer_done: the project transfer was already decided
blocked.route_done: the route is already signed or stopped, or this person no longer signs
blocked.object_gone: the object of the email no longer exists
blocked.over_limit: did not fit into this run: at most {{limit}} emails at a time
blocked.unknown: the email is out of date ({{code}})

batch.title: Send unsent emails
batch.lead: The Studio will send again the emails that did not go out in the last 3 days, if they are still relevant. Emails with token links are not resent.
batch.started: Sending: the emails will appear in the log.
batch.failed: Could not count the emails. Try again.
batch.smtpOff: Mail is not set up: set it up first.
